records.name: Holmesburg Civic Association
records.summary: A neighborhood group the City of Philadelphia has registered to be consulted on zoning and development in the North Delaware part of the city, Holmesburg Civic Association gives neighbors a place to hear about projects and respond.
records.what_you_do: Members follow zoning and development plans in the area and meet to talk them over.

first_step.how: Email or call the contact listed for this group to ask when and where the next meeting is held.

records.notes: No own website. The website in the City list is a Facebook page, which I did not read (lead only). One WebSearch returned Northeast Times items; the two articles I tried to open returned HTTP 403 and are listed under blocked, so nothing from them is recorded as fact. The unverified search summary pointed to older Tuesday evening meetings at the Holmesburg Recreation Center and to an older phone number that differs from the City list number. Both are worth a human check. Status set to unknown for lack of readable dated evidence; tier 1 active came from the City list date.

records.name: Mayfair Business Improvement District (BID)
records.summary: The business improvement district for shops along Frankford and Cottman avenues in Mayfair. It runs the Third Thursday Night Market and other public events, and promotes local businesses.
records.what_you_do: Runs public events, promotes the businesses in the district, and has worked on storefront grants and avenue improvements (per its 2019 report).

schedule.text: Third Thursday Night Market on the third Thursday of the market season, 6 to 9:30 pm, at Frankford and Cottman avenues.

locations.label: Office
locations.address: 2990 St. Vincent St., 2nd Floor, Philadelphia, PA 19149

locations.label: Third Thursday Night Market
locations.address: Frankford Avenue and Cottman Avenue, Philadelphia, PA

first_step.how: Walk over to a Third Thursday Night Market at Frankford and Cottman avenues, 6 to 9:30 pm. Sign up for the BID newsletter on its homepage if you want the season's dates.
first_step.basis: Public evening market with a set time and place on the homepage. The site lists no volunteer or membership path, so attending the market is the clear way in.
first_step.what_to_expect: The Third Thursday Night Market is a public evening event from 6 to 9:30 pm at Frankford and Cottman avenues, held on the third Thursday of the season. The homepage does not state an admission cost or ask visitors to register. Plan to walk the avenue and stop at the shops along it.
first_visit_tips: Check the homepage for the current season's market dates, since the dates on the page carry no year.
Call or email the BID (contact details are on the homepage) to ask how neighbors can take part.

records.notes: Re-scoped: this is a business improvement district, not a civic association, so the civic_association tag was removed and the summary was rewritten from the group's own site. The site does not discuss zoning; the City list still registers it as a community organization. Market dates on the homepage have no year, so the schedule text carries none. Status probably_active: the newest dated item is the news item of April 2, 2025. The homepage's 'for 2026' mention of the sculpture return has no month and was not used. The market location has no zip on the page. Cost is not stated, so it is left at tier 1 (unknown). A guessed URL (/whats-happening-mayfair/) returned 404; that is a dead link, not a block.

records.name: Tacony CDC
records.summary: Tacony CDC is the community development corporation for the Tacony neighborhood. It works on the Torresdale Avenue storefronts, helps people open businesses, works on parks and trails such as the Disston Park Trail, and hosts community events such as Third Thursdays.
records.what_you_do: Works with Torresdale Avenue storefronts and local shops, helps people open a business, and promotes parks, trails and local history. Hosts community events, including the monthly Third Thursdays gathering.

schedule.text: Third Thursdays: a community gathering on the third Thursday of each month, 6 to 9 pm, with family activities, food, produce and live music.

first_step.how: Come to a Third Thursdays gathering at Costello Boxing Gym, 6846 Torresdale Avenue, on the third Thursday evening, 6 to 9 pm.
first_step.basis: Open community gathering with a set monthly date, time and place on the CDC events page. The page describes no volunteer or membership path, so attending is the clear way in.
first_step.what_to_expect: Third Thursdays runs from 6 to 9 pm on the third Thursday of the month at Costello Boxing Gym on Torresdale Avenue. The events page describes family activities, food, produce and live music, so expect families among the crowd. The page does not state a cost, so ask the CDC before you come if cost matters.
first_visit_tips: Bring the family, since the events page lists family activities.
Check the CDC Facebook page for the current month, because the site points there for current dates.
Ask the CDC office about cost and access before you come, since the site does not say.

records.notes: The City list calls this a Neighborhood Advisory Committee (city_nac:20). The group's own site calls itself a community development corporation, so the summary was rewritten and kind changed from civic to nonprofit. Status probably_active: the newest dated item on its site is the April 29, 2025 blog post. The Third Thursdays start date is printed with no year and was not used. The gym's zip is not on the page, so it is left out. Office zip and coordinates are kept from tier 1. The site lists no membership fees and no volunteer page; donations only.

records.name: Tacony Civic Association
records.summary: Tacony Civic Association is a neighborhood membership group in Tacony. It holds general membership meetings several times a year and lists local projects that neighbors can join, such as the Disston Park and Community Garden, a yard sale, and Hometown Hero banners. The City also registers it as a community organization to be consulted on nearby zoning and development.
records.what_you_do: Members meet at general membership meetings, and the group lists projects neighbors can take part in, including the Disston Park and Community Garden, a yard sale, and Hometown Hero banners.

schedule.text: General membership meetings on the second Wednesday of the month at 7 pm, held in January, March, May, September and November. The meeting room is announced in the newsletter and on the website.

locations.label: Meeting place (City list)
locations.address: Tacony Free Library, 6742 Torresdale Ave., Philadelphia, PA 19135

first_step.how: Email taconycivicassociation@gmail.com to ask which room the next general membership meeting is in, then come on the second Wednesday at 7 pm.
first_step.basis: A membership form is posted, but the site gives no dues and does not say whether visitors may attend meetings, so the way in is unclear.
first_step.what_to_expect: The site describes the general membership meetings but not what happens at them, how long they run, or who attends. Membership is through a form on the site, and no dues amount is stated. Ask the association before your first meeting.
first_visit_tips: Ask whether visitors are welcome at general membership meetings before you come.
Watch the newsletter or the website for the meeting room, since the site says it is announced there.
Read the membership form on the site to see the dues before you join.

records.notes: The tier 1 website (taconycivic.org) returns a 301 to the association's Google Sites page, which I followed. The site publishes taconycivicassociation@gmail.com as its contact; contacts.email still holds the City list address tcazoning@gmail.com, for the orchestrator to choose between. The meeting room is announced rather than fixed, so the Tacony Free Library address is the City list's. The site shows only an undated yard sale notice and no dated events, so status is probably_active (working site, no dates) and no last_sign_of_life was sent; tier 1 2026-10 came from the City list date. No dues amount is stated; a membership form is posted. The site has no accessibility statement. Partner groups named on the site are in leads_only.

records.name: Upper Holmesburg Civic Association
records.summary: Upper Holmesburg Civic Association is a Registered Community Organization (RCO) in the North Delaware part of the city. The City asks developers to talk with RCOs about nearby zoning and building plans, so this is a way for neighbors to have a say.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers work on local issues and look for practical solutions with city leaders and elected officials. The association meets monthly and invites people who live or work in Upper Holmesburg to take part.

schedule.text: Monthly association meetings. The site does not give the day, time or place.

locations.label: Meeting place (City list)
locations.address: St. Dominic Marian Hall, 8532 Frankford Ave., Philadelphia PA 19136

cost.text: Membership dues are listed as $10 regular, $5 senior and $25 business. The page does not give the period.

first_step.how: Ask the association for the time and place of its next monthly meeting, then attend and see how it runs.
first_step.basis: The site invites neighbors who live or work in the area to the monthly meetings, but gives no meeting time or place and lists membership dues, so the way in is unclear.
first_step.what_to_expect: The association meets monthly, and the site invites people who live or work in Upper Holmesburg. Its volunteers work on local issues with city leaders and elected officials, but the site does not describe how long a meeting runs or what happens there. Membership dues are listed on the site, so check the period before you pay.
first_visit_tips: Confirm the meeting time and place before you go, since the site does not list them.
Look at the Become a Member page for the dues before you decide to join.
Ask about upcoming meetings directly, since the Events page lists none.

records.notes: Own site read. The membership page lists three dues levels with no period. The homepage shows 'Next meeting 10/15' with no year, time, or place, so it is not used as dated evidence, and the Events page lists no events. Status probably_active (working site, no dated items); last_sign_of_life was not sent because tier 1 2026-10 came from the City list date. Summary and interests kept from tier 1. The mission page adds that the group is a nonprofit focused on community development, improvement, and preservation.

notes: Batch 13, seven groups. Own sites read: Mayfair BID, Tacony CDC, Tacony Civic (taconycivic.org redirects to its Google Sites page, which I followed), and Upper Holmesburg. Holme Circle, Holmesburg, and Mayfair Civic list only Facebook pages, which I did not read under the lead only rule, so those three records are thin and confidence is low. Status changes from tier 1 (active): Tacony CDC and Mayfair BID to probably_active (newest dated items April 2025); Tacony Civic and Upper Holmesburg to probably_active (working sites with no dated items); Holme Circle, Holmesburg, and Mayfair Civic to unknown (no dated evidence I could read). Tier 1 last_sign_of_life 2026-10 values came from City list seen dates, not dated posts, so none were carried. Tacony CDC kind changed to nonprofit: its site calls it a community development corporation, while the City list calls it a Neighborhood Advisory Committee. Tacony Civic publishes taconycivicassociation@gmail.com, but contacts.email still holds the City list address tcazoning@gmail.com for the orchestrator to choose.
